entities.summary: Olga Viktorovna Nikolaeva (Russian: Ольга Викторовна Николаева, is a Russian former volleyball player. She was a member of the national team that won the silver medal at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens. She played for Dynamo Moscow.
